lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Commander,

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: are you busy right now?
I'm not.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: In that case,

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: have you eaten?
Not yet, but I could go for some food.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: That's perfect!

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Want to try out some food I just whipped up?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I'm afraid I'm no longer confident

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: in my cooking recently.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: That's why I need someone to give me some feedback, but

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I can't find Eunhwa and Vesti anywhere :(
Now that I think about it, I'm not that hungry.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Oh, really? :(

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Then...

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: you can have it later!

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Just be sure to tell me how it tastes!
Umm... what exactly is it?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: It's fried-chicken-flavored chocolate!

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Sweet and salty always go together, don't you agree?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: It can satisfy both your appetite and sweet tooth all in one go.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: It's like killing two birds with one stone!
To be honest, I'm not really sold on that...

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Oh no! Do you not like sweets?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: But I've really put my heart into this :(

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: or will mackerel bread be better?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: That's the next dish I was going to prepare.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: If you want,

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I can make some mackerel bread and...
Actually, I'm not feeling too well...

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Oh my.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Do you need to go to the hospital? :(
I think so.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Then I will make some porridge and bring it over!

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I just so happen to have some raw mackerel Splendamin.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I'll grind that up and toss it into the mix

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: so it'll be easier to digest.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: You know what, Commander?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I think I've regained my confidence in the kitchen again!

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Just as I thought,

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: cooking is always best when you're making dishes for someone else!

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Just thinking about my cooking helping soothe your upset stomach

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: motivates me like never before!

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Hurry and get yourself to the hospital!

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I'll whip that porridge up and be there in a jiffy.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: At this rate, you'll be better in no time! :3
... I should avoid Emma for a while.
